tweets.text:
Grok Bot nailed the personal "context graph."

This is an absolutely incredible product that will unlock the latent demand of millions of users that barely use AI every week. 

In what felt like a jaw dropping customer experience, the Cursor team clearly nailed the minimalist interface enough for "normies"  while keeping the quality and bar for "day to day EA / Chief of Staff / COO" like tasks. The craft shines through in the way the product is designed.

Clearly, this team will nail the proactive angle everyone's been waiting for: learning your workflows, patterns, and preferences over time, then suggesting or spinning up relevant tasks and routines based on what it knows about you. 

If you haven't tried it, I highly recommend it, especially for people who don't use AI every second of the day.

A few more people sent over in DM:

1.) a few researchers that claim they turned down offers at OpenAI and Anthropic to start the company but are not in the ATS at either company 

2.) Claims that certain companies are using the research / product but nobody is using
